title: Cost Governance
subtitle: Server-filtered cost observations, optimization cases, and verified outcomes
unavailable: Cost Governance is not enabled or compatible for this deployment.
accessRequired: A current Cost Governance access grant is required.
empty: No retained observations are available for this view.
emptyHint: The workspace is enabled, but no authoritative cost observations have been retained yet.
incomplete: The source reports incomplete evidence. Treat these values as provisional.

evidence.disclosureNotReported: Disclosure policy was not reported by this projection.
evidence.partialNoReason: The source reports partial readiness without a reason.
evidence.unavailableNoReason: The source reports this evidence as unavailable.
evidence.readyNoRecords: Ready; no owned records were returned.
evidence.sourcesNotReported: Source-level coverage was not reported by this projection.
evidence.runCountValues: {observations} observations; {trend} trend points; {budgets} budgets; {recommendations} recommendations; {utilization} utilization records
evidence.reasonFallback: The source reported an unavailable reason.

reasons.analytics_run_missing: No analytics run receipt is available.
reasons.analytics_run_partial: The latest analytics run is partial.
reasons.analytics_stale: The latest analytics snapshot is stale.
reasons.disclosure_insufficient: The effective disclosure policy does not permit this view.
reasons.resource_candidates_missing: No complete resource candidates are projected.
reasons.candidate_evidence_incomplete: Candidate identity, recommendation, utilization, or configuration evidence is incomplete.
reasons.decision_cases_missing: No agent-owned decision cases are projected.
reasons.settlements_missing: No independently owned settlements are projected.

metrics.undisclosedTotal: The total is not disclosed at this access level
metrics.budgetCurrentSpend: Current spend from the selected budget
metrics.belowRoundingExplanation: Positive amount below the disclosure rounding increment

overview.title: Observed cost by service
overview.description: Compare disclosed service costs from the current authoritative observation window.
overview.trendDescription: Compare cumulative observed cost with forecast and budget evidence when those projections are available.
overview.trendUnavailableBody: The current projection contains service totals but no dated trend points.
overview.flowDescription: Follow disclosed cost from the authorized subscription scope into service groups and resource detail.
overview.driversDescription: Relative changes against a comparable prior window.
overview.driversUnavailableBody: A prior-period baseline and relative-change projection are required before cost drivers can be ranked.

attention.title: Review before deciding
attention.description: Review operating evidence and constraints before considering cost amounts.

resource.title: Highest observed service costs
resource.description: Rank service groups by disclosed cost. Utilization and SKU evidence remain separate and unavailable.
resource.candidateMetrics: A compatible utilization metric for each candidate
resource.mapDescription: Bubble height reflects disclosed cost. Horizontal placement is only layout while utilization evidence is unavailable.
resource.recommendationMapDescription: Bubble height reflects projected monthly provider savings. Horizontal position uses each candidate's compatible measured utilization.
resource.mapUnavailableBody: The map requires disclosed numeric amounts in one currency. Banded, suppressed, or mixed-currency values remain separate.
resource.utilizationAxisUnavailable: Utilization axis unavailable - horizontal position has no operational meaning
resource.tableDescription: Review service objectives and evidence completeness before projected savings.
resource.serviceTableDescription: Compare disclosed service aggregates. Resource identity, SKU, utilization, and decisions are not available in this mode.
resource.candidateTableDescription: Review pseudonymous provider candidates with compatible utilization and configuration evidence.
resource.noServiceSummaries: No service-cost summaries match these filters.
resource.noCandidates: No resource candidates match these filters.
resource.monthlyAdvisorEstimate: Monthly equivalent of Advisor annual estimate
resource.noMatches: No service groups match these filters.
resource.recommendationUnavailable: Cost evidence alone cannot support a SKU, scale, schedule, or retirement recommendation.
resource.freyrUnavailable: Capacity and utilization evidence is unavailable.
resource.forsetiUnavailable: No grounded decision has been issued.
resource.noChangesApplied: No changes are applied from this view.
resource.candidateAuthorityBoundary: This provider candidate is evidence only. It is not an FDAI decision, approval, or execution instruction.

service_summary.title: Service-cost summary
service_summary.description: The source disclosed service aggregates only. Resource identity, SKU, utilization, and decision fields are intentionally omitted.

resource_candidate.title: Resource candidates
resource_candidate.description: Each row has pseudonymous identity, a provider recommendation, compatible utilization evidence, and current and proposed configuration.

table.title: Service cost evidence
table.description: Disclosed observations only. This table does not infer efficiency or a recommended action.

cases.title: Optimization case readiness
cases.description: Cost observations are available, but no governed DecisionCase projection is connected.
cases.candidateOnly: {count} Advisor candidates; no FDAI decision yet
cases.notDecisionCase: Provider candidate only - no FDAI decision, approval, or execution authority
cases.mixDescription: Keep savings and cost increases separate on the same evidence axis.
cases.effectsUnavailableBody: Decision cases with typed expected effects are required before opportunity values can be shown.
cases.effectsNotInContract: The current case projection contains observed cost but no typed expected-effect amount.
cases.flowDescription: Each stage is counted only from its independently owned record.
cases.listDescription: A large projected amount cannot proceed when operating constraints are unresolved.
cases.readinessDescription: Only Forseti-owned DecisionCase records are presented as optimization cases.
cases.readyOwnedRecords: The source reports complete owned decision-case evidence.
cases.unavailableBody: Utilization, SKU alternatives, objectives, and decision records are required before FDAI can present an optimization case.

outcomes.title: Observed cost basis and verified outcomes
outcomes.description: Keep observed spend separate from projected opportunity and independently verified savings.
outcomes.independentlySettled: Sum of complete independently settled effects
outcomes.sampleEvidence: Synthetic presentation value; not operational evidence
outcomes.projectedRecords: {count} outcome records projected; savings amount unavailable
outcomes.failedServiceEffects: Failed service effects in owned outcomes
outcomes.unresolvedHint: Pending, censored, unscorable, or rollback outcomes
outcomes.statusDescription: Failed, censored, unscorable, rollback, and pending outcomes remain separate from verified savings.
outcomes.rollbackObserved: Rollback requested; independent recovery observation is recorded.
outcomes.rollbackPending: Rollback requested; recovery observation is still pending.
outcomes.actionLineageUnavailable: {count} settlement records are unavailable because exact action identity and revision were not reported.
outcomes.waterfallDescription: Subtract overlap, protection cost, pending observation, and unrealized effects.
outcomes.unitDescription: Normalize cost against workload demand before claiming efficiency.
outcomes.unitUnavailableBody: Request volume and a comparable baseline are not projected.
outcomes.effectDescription: A case does not close when cost improves but an operating objective fails.
outcomes.unavailableBody: Savings remain unavailable until an action has an expected effect and an independent authoritative observation closes its settlement window.

settings.title: Cost Governance
settings.activationHint: Makes the workspace and collection jobs available. Action promotion and execution authority remain unchanged.
settings.notInstalled: The package is not installed in this deployment.
settings.ownerRequired: Owner role is required to change package activation.
settings.conflict: Activation changed in another session. The latest state has been loaded.
